To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the electric drive system with a brushless electric drive is more suitable for an exoskeleton, since it provides the same kinematic parameters of the exo-joints with lower requirements for the control system and mass of the exoskeletal device.
the brushless DC electric drive with the vector control is more suitable for the exoskeletons than the electric drive with the valve.
the exoskeleton with a synchronous electric drive is more suitable for use in exoskeletons.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of the knee joint of exoskeleton, which is a part of a full exoskeleton.
the development of exoskeletal systems with electric drives.
the development of a new exoskeleton with a synchronous electric drive.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the electric drive system with a brushless synchronous motor is preferable for exoskeleton construction.
the brushless DC electric drive is more suitable for use in the exoskeleton.
the electric drive based on the brushless DC motor with a vector control system is more suitable for the construction of exoskeleton systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the electric drive of exoskeleton with brushless DC motor has a higher level of reliability and efficiency.
it is necessary to continue the research and development of exo-skeletons with synchronous brushless electric drive.
the use of the valve electric drive is possible only in the case of the use of the exoskeletal system with a large mass of the electromechanical part.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is necessary to use brushless DC motors for the electric drive of exoskeleton joints.
the exoskeleton with the brushless electric drive is a more suitable solution for the knee joint exo-skeleton.
the electric drive of the exoskeletal electromechanical part should be chosen taking into account the specific features of the exoskelet.
